get.description:
Get daily ACU consumption for the entire enterprise.

Returns total ACUs and consumption broken down by date.

**Timezone behavior**: Billing cycles use midnight PST (Pacific Standard Time)
as the day boundary, which corresponds to 08:00:00 UTC. To match the consumption
data shown in the Devin dashboard, pass Unix timestamps that align with this
timezone offset (e.g., 1733385600 for December 5, 2025 at midnight PST).

**Timezone behavior**: Billing cycles use midnight PST (Pacific Standard Time)
as the day boundary, which corresponds to 08:00:00 UTC. To match the consumption
data shown in the Devin dashboard, pass Unix timestamps that align with this
timezone offset (e.g., 1733385600 for December 5, 2025 at midnight PST).

post.description:
Launch a Devin session to remediate a code scan finding.

The session analyzes the vulnerable code, implements a fix, and opens a
pull request. The session is attributed to the calling principal (the
service user or PAT that made the request). Returns ``409`` if the finding
already has a remediation session.

Launch one Devin session to remediate several findings of a code scan.

A batch of two or more findings (which may span repositories) gets a
planner session that groups them and launches a fix session per group,
each on its own branch with its own pull request. A single finding gets a
fix session directly. The session is attributed to the calling principal.
Returns ``409`` if any finding already has a remediation session, in which
case none of them is claimed.

Instead of ``finding_ids``, ``select_all`` remediates every open finding
matching its filters that is not already being remediated.

Switch the profile applied to future incremental runs of a scan.

Incremental re-scans pick up their profile through the scan's profile
link, so repointing the link changes the profile used from the next run
onward. Completed runs and their findings are unaffected. The new
profile must have the same scan type and mode as the current one, and
the scan must not have an active run (``409`` otherwise).

post.description:
Immediately trigger an incremental (diff) scan of new commits.

Re-runs the scan against only the commits landed since it last completed.
This is the one-off, on-demand form of the auto-scan schedule. Returns
``409`` if the scan has no completed run to extend or is already in
progress.

Start an ingestion-mode code scan on one or more repositories in an organization.

The scan is enqueued and launched asynchronously by the scan dispatcher.
Only ingest-mode profiles are accepted; a non-ingest profile is rejected
with ``400``. Optional attachment URLs (uploaded via the attachments API)
are provided to the scan. Returns ``409`` when the organization's scan
backlog is at capacity.

Create the recurring auto-scan schedule for a code scan.

Auto-scan is backed by an automation with a ``schedule:recurring`` trigger
(carrying the rrule) and a ``scan_new_commits`` action targeting this
scan; when the schedule fires, commits landed since the last scan are
scanned. Create-only: returns ``409`` if the scan already has a schedule
(delete it first to change it).

delete.description:

Deletes the underlying schedule automation. Idempotent: returns ``204``
even when no schedule is configured.

metadata labels (exact match; multiple filters AND together).

`agent_types` filters to automations containing at least one action of a

queryable columns, so this filter scans pages server-side. `total` is
only returned when a single unfiltered scan covered the whole result set
(first page, no further pages, nothing hidden); otherwise it is omitted
rather than reporting a count that includes automations the API will
never return.

Launch a Devin session to remediate a code scan finding.

The session analyzes the vulnerable code, implements a fix, and opens a
pull request. The session is attributed to the calling principal (the
service user or PAT that made the request). Returns ``409`` if the finding
already has a remediation session.

A batch of two or more findings (which may span repositories) gets a
planner session that groups them and launches a fix session per group,
each on its own branch with its own pull request. A single finding gets a
fix session directly. The session is attributed to the calling principal.

case none of them is claimed.

matching its filters that is not already being remediated.

sides. Element members that are required on create (``prompt``,
``setup_prompt``, the monitor/triage slack configs, ``scan_id``) may be
omitted when a counterpart exists — they carry like any other member;
explicit null is rejected.

host.description: Git host of the repository, if known.

repos.title: Repos
repos.description: Repositories covered by one scan; the first entry is the scan's primary repository. Provide exactly one of repo_name or repos.

profile_id.title: Profile Id
profile_id.description: Ingestion-mode scan profile to run. Must be an ingest profile; non-ingest profiles are rejected with 400.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: Scan effort: 'normal' (default) uses lower model reasoning effort with larger triage and validation batches; 'deep' runs the full pipeline.

attachment_urls.title: Attachment Urls
attachment_urls.description: Devin attachment URLs to provide to the scan, e.g. files uploaded via the attachments API. The attachments must belong to the organization being scanned.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: Where the scan's sessions run: a platform label configured for the organization (e.g. 'linux', 'windows', 'macos') or the name of an outpost (BYOB) pool, case-insensitive; platforms take priority when a name matches both. Omitted means the organization default. Unrecognized values are rejected with a 400 whose error body lists the available platform labels and outpost pool names.

StartIngestionScanRequest.title: StartIngestionScanRequest
StartIngestionScanRequest.description:
Request body for starting an ingestion-mode code scan.

Only accepts an ingestion (ingest-mode) scan profile: the profile is run
against the given repository (or repositories).

TriggerBuildBody.title: TriggerBuildBody
TriggerBuildBody.description: ``POST /builds`` body. Empty per spec; reserved for future fields.

contents.title: Contents
contents.description: New YAML body for the blueprint.

contents.title: Contents
contents.description: If set, replaces the blueprint's YAML body with a new version.

position.title: Position
position.description: If set, updates the execution position of this repo-tier blueprint. Positions are not required to be unique; ties are broken arbitrarily by the server when sorting for execution.

source.title: Source
source.description: If set, switches the repo's blueprint source. Only accepted on the repo's root blueprint (scoped blueprints inherit it). 'git' pulls .devin/blueprint.yaml from the default branch (404 if absent) and cannot be combined with 'contents'; 'database' keeps the current YAML (or 'contents', if given) and stops syncing from the repo. No-op when the blueprint is already in that mode.

build_on_default_branch_commit.title: Build On Default Branch Commit
build_on_default_branch_commit.description: If set, turns building the environment on each push to the default branch on or off. Only accepted on the root blueprint of a github.com repo. Every such push queues a build.

report_check_runs.title: Report Check Runs
report_check_runs.description: If set, turns reporting each commit build as a GitHub check run on or off. Enabling it requires 'build_on_default_branch_commit' to be on.

UpdateOrgBlueprintBody.title: UpdateOrgBlueprintBody
UpdateOrgBlueprintBody.description:
Partial update for an org- or repo-tier blueprint.

Any subset of fields may be provided. Fields not set are left alone.
Providing ``position``, ``source`` or a commit-build setting on an
org-tier blueprint returns ``400`` — only repo-tier blueprints have them.
Does NOT trigger a build.

UserWithIdpRoles.title: UserWithIdpRoles
UserWithIdpRoles.description: User with both direct and IDP-group-derived role assignments.

devin_sessions_org_id.title: Devin Sessions Org Id
devin_sessions_org_id.description: Organization the caller's Devin Cloud sessions run in: the one named with x-cog-org-id, or without it the first organization visible to the user. Either way only an organization in which the user may use Devin sessions, and never an enterprise's primary organization. Null when there is none.

primary_billing_org_id.title: Primary Billing Org Id
primary_billing_org_id.description: Organization the user's CLI and Desktop usage is billed to: the account's organization, or in an enterprise the user's primary billing organization. Null when there is none or the user may not use Devin sessions in it.

WindsurfSessionUserSelf.title: WindsurfSessionUserSelf
WindsurfSessionUserSelf.description: Identity information for an authenticated Windsurf session user.
